recordings.location: Blue Mountains National Park, New South Wales
recordings.remarks:
Close-up recording of a pair of Eastern Whipbirds. First the male and then the female responds, almost next to the microphone.
This excerpt was gathered from a 14hr long recording where I left my microphones unattended in the Jamison Valley, Blue Mountains. I was no where near at the time. This particular area of the Jamison Valley where I left my microphones is covered in wet sclerophyll forest and is bellow the Narrow Neck Plateau a few hundred metres above. It is bordered by warm-temperate rainforest and dry sclerophyll forest.
